children.innerHTML: A small practice for brands, spaces and the things they make.
Aker works with founders and institutions on identity, environments and product. Established 2019. Deliberately small.

We take on a handful of projects a year and stay close to each one. The same three people who pitch you do the work, answer the phone and stand behind the result. No handovers, no juniors learning on your budget.
Naming, systems and guidelines that get used.
Interiors, signage and wayfinding for real footfall.
Sites and products, designed and shipped.
A standing seat at your table, monthly.
We take on six projects a year. Two slots remain for spring. Write a few lines about what you are making; we reply within two days.

meta_description: A small design and strategy practice: identity, spaces, digital and counsel. Six projects a year, the same people throughout.
